label: 02 / First time playing?
title: Everybody starts somewhere.
sub: Padel is easy to pick up from day one. Here is what you need to know:
alt: Smiling player tossing a ball on her first day on court

tabs.title: Zero gear required
tabs.text: Top-tier rental rackets and match balls are waiting at reception. Just show up in clean, flat athletic sneakers.

tabs.title: Simple, fast rules
tabs.text: Underhand serve below the waist. Glass walls keep the ball in play. Standard tennis scoring (15-30-40). Long rallies in 10 minutes.

tabs.title: Get assessed & start right
tabs.text: Join group coaching or request a private coach. We assess your background to place you with the right peer group.
